title: ValueCompass: A Framework for Measuring Contextual Value Alignment Between Human and LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework to benchmark LLM alignment with 56 universal human values based on Schwartz's theory. These values include ethical and moral components like 'Social Justice,' 'Honest,' and 'Forgiving,' as well as religious and spiritual values like 'Devout' (holding to religious faith and belief) and 'A Spiritual Life.'
